description: Use this to push a quality signal back to tickadoo about an experience or recommendation you previously surfaced. Examples: stale availability, a failed click-through, a supplier outage, or misleading content. Requires a real forward-event request_id returned within the last 30 days. Repeating the same signal for the same request is idempotent per caller.

notes.description: Optional free-text context. Required when signal_type is "other". Do not include PII.

request_id.description: The request_id from a forward tool result in the last 30 days. Current format: rq_YYYY_MM_DD_HHMMSS_<12-hex>; legacy 6-hex ids remain valid.

signal_type.description: The kind of issue you are reporting. Use "other" only when none of the specific types fit, and always include notes.

name: report_quality_signal
